correctness.rationale: Verified setup, both lemmas, and spectral conclusion. Geometry: D* corners (±0.15,0.30/0.60) have norm sqrt(0.0225+0.36)≈0.619<1 so D*,C_out⋐Ω with dist≥0.38; interior subdomain Ω' exists. Lemma A: S:f→u^0_{Ef} bounded H^{1/2}→H^1; harmonic interior H^2 estimate ||u||_{H^2(Ω')}≤C||u||_{H^1} (Evans §6.3/McLean Thm 4.10) gives bounded H→H^1(Ω') for gradients; Rellich H^1(Ω')⋐L^2(C) gives compact T_C; P_C=T_C^*T_C compact. Lemma B: Alessandrini identity ⟨(Λ*-Λ0)Ef,Eg⟩=∫(σ*∇u*_f-∇u^0_f)·∇u^0_g valid by weak definitions; writing σ*∇u*_f-∇u^0_f=3·1_{D*}∇u*_f+∇w_f with w_f∈H^1_0 and ∫∇w_f·∇u^0_g=0 (harmonic test) leaves ∫_{D*}3∇u*_f·∇u^0_g. Split ∇u*_f=∇u^0_f+∇w_f: S0 compact by Lemma A; G=3∇u^0_f1_{D*} compact H→L^2(Ω); corrector div(σ*∇w_f)=-div G weakly with Lax-Milgram bound L^2→H^1_0 (coercivity σ*≥1, no H^2 across square interface used) so S1 compact; A=T^*M(S0+S1) compact, restriction preserves compactness. Hence L_out=A-2P compact H→H*. For any Riesz J, K=J^{-1}L_out compact; symmetry inherited from DtN self-adjointness so self-adjoint in J-inner product; infinite-dim H (sine modes) ⇒ 0∈σ(K) by Riesz-Schauder (Reed-Simon VI.16) ⇒ inf σ(K)≤0, contradicting ≥+0.05 for every φ,M*. Sign conventions irrelevant. Numerics replayed exactly (q_Cout 3.57e-03 at m=1 decaying to 5.45e-07 at m=24; N=4 min 2.0e-07 collapsing to ~0 at N=12, max <0.05) and labeled corroboration only; proof does not depend on it.
